title: Français 3613 — Rondinelli, ff62r–v
contents: Rondinelli describes Catholic dissatisfaction, preparations against Paris, and doubts about the Duke of Mena protecting the city.
fields: 32 symbols: 23 letter/vowel forms, 5 in nomenclature, 2 nulls, 2 controls
Original key in a different volume: Français 3995, f89r.

excerpt: **… dalla necessita io non posso credere che l signor duca di Mena sia bastante per difenderla, uedendosi che egli si consiglia et si gouerna per l'auiso di quelli che desiderano la sua ruina.**
translation: …because of the necessity, I cannot believe that the Duke of Mena is capable of defending it, seeing that he takes counsel and governs himself according to the advice of those who desire his ruin.
